description:
The AICTE-LILAVATI AWARD is a prestigious initiative launched by the All India Council for Technical Education (AICTE) in 2020. 

The award is named after Lilavati, a character from an ancient Indian text who symbolizes women's empowerment and education. 

The primary objective of the AICTE-LILAVATI AWARD is to promote gender equity in technical education and empower women in the field of engineering and technology. 

The award aims to recognize and honor the efforts of institutions that have made significant contributions towards the empowerment of women. 

The AICTE-LILAVATI AWARD focuses on various aspects of women's empowerment including education, skill development, and entrepreneurship. 

The award encourages institutions to create an environment conducive to women's participation in technical education. 

The AICTE-LILAVATI AWARD has specific measurable targets. 

It aims to increase the enrollment of female students in technical courses by at least 30% over a five-year period. 

The award also seeks to enhance the participation of women faculty in technical institutions by 25% within the same timeframe. 

The benefits of the AICTE-LILAVATI AWARD include recognition at a national level for institutions that excel in promoting gender equity. 

Institutions that receive the award can gain financial assistance for projects aimed at furthering women's empowerment. 

The financial assistance can range from INR 1 lakh to INR 5 lakhs depending on the nature and scope of the project proposed. 

The eligibility criteria for the AICTE-LILAVATI AWARD include being a recognized technical institution under AICTE. 

Institutions must demonstrate a commitment to women's empowerment through various initiatives and programs. 

There are no specific age limits or educational requirements for institutions applying for this award. 

However, institutions must provide evidence of their efforts in promoting gender equity and women's participation in technical education. 

The application process for the AICTE-LILAVATI AWARD involves several steps. 

Institutions must first register on the AICTE website to access the application form. 

Once registered, institutions can download the application form and guidelines for the award. 

The completed application form must be submitted online along with supporting documents that highlight the institution's initiatives. 

Supporting documents may include reports on women's enrollment, faculty participation, and details of programs conducted for women's empowerment. 

The deadline for submitting applications for the AICTE-LILAVATI AWARD is typically set for the end of April each year. 

The evaluation of applications is conducted by a committee appointed by AICTE. 

The committee reviews the applications based on predefined criteria related to women's empowerment initiatives. 

Winners of the AICTE-LILAVATI AWARD are announced during the annual AICTE conference held in June. 

Institutions that win the award are invited to present their initiatives at this conference. 

The implementing authority for the AICTE-LILAVATI AWARD is the All India Council for Technical Education. 

AICTE is a statutory body under the Ministry of Education, Government of India. 

The contact details for AICTE can be found on their official website. 

The AICTE-LILAVATI AWARD is part of a broader initiative to enhance women's representation in technical fields. 

The initiative aligns with the national policy on education which emphasizes gender equity in education. 

The award also contributes to the Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs) particularly Goal 5 which focuses on gender equality. 

As of 2023, several institutions have been recognized under the AICTE-LILAVATI AWARD for their exemplary work. 

These institutions have implemented various programs including mentorship for female students and skill development workshops. 

The AICTE-LILAVATI AWARD has garnered attention from various stakeholders in the education sector. 

It has encouraged more institutions to prioritize gender equity in their policies and practices. 

The award serves as a benchmark for other institutions to aspire towards in promoting women's empowerment. 

The AICTE-LILAVATI AWARD also provides a platform for sharing best practices among institutions. 

This sharing of knowledge helps in scaling successful initiatives across different regions. 

The award has been instrumental in changing perceptions about women's roles in technical education. 

It has highlighted the importance of creating supportive environments for female students and faculty. 

The AICTE-LILAVATI AWARD is a step towards bridging the gender gap in technical education in India. 

The initiative has received positive feedback from various educational institutions and stakeholders. 

The award not only recognizes achievements but also motivates institutions to continue their efforts in this domain. 

The AICTE-LILAVATI AWARD is a significant contribution to the ongoing discourse on gender equality in education. 

It reflects the commitment of the Indian government towards empowering women through education and skill development. 

The award is expected to evolve over the years with new criteria and categories being introduced. 

The AICTE-LILAVATI AWARD is a vital component of India's efforts to enhance women's participation in STEM fields. 

The initiative is expected to inspire future generations of women to pursue careers in engineering and technology. 

In conclusion, the AICTE-LILAVATI AWARD is a comprehensive initiative aimed at promoting gender equity in technical education. 

It provides a structured framework for institutions to engage in meaningful efforts towards women's empowerment. 

The award not only recognizes achievements but also encourages continuous improvement in gender equity initiatives. 

The AICTE-LILAVATI AWARD is a testament to the changing landscape of education in India. 

It signifies a collective effort towards creating a more inclusive and equitable educational environment. 

The initiative is poised to have a lasting impact on the future of women's education in India.
